nodes.label: Valence singles E2s in V^(N-1)
nodes.rationale: Non-zero precisely because the sealed AOC entrant orbital is not an eigenfunction of h_core - the sealed kernel sees its own AOC potential - so Brillouin's theorem fails and the singles term must be computed rather than assumed away.

nodes.label: Brillouin failure for the AOC orbital
nodes.rationale: Both sign predictions follow from the V^(N-1) operator lacking the valence electron's own attraction, which lifts the core roots above eps_c; the lever-dead check applies the formula to a core-occupied orbital of the same l, which must vanish to the 1e-3 level of F95.4.

nodes.label: dm2_singles = E2s(7p) - E2s(6d) > 0
nodes.rationale: Predicted smaller than the doubles differential (+0.041) with a 1e-4 Ha firing bar, so singles are bounded against the piece already filed rather than reported in isolation.
